pan_india_dataset.dataset_name: Pan-India Multi-Basin Hydrometeorological and Remote-Sensing Dataset (2018-2023)
pan_india_dataset.source: ECMWF ERA5-Land Reanalysis, USGS SRTM 30m Digital Elevation Model (GEE), CIESIN GPWv4 Global Population (GEE), Copernicus Sentinel-1 Dual-Pol SAR, Central Water Commission (CWC) Gauge Reports
pan_india_dataset.license: Copernicus Open Access / Open-Meteo CC BY 4.0 / NASA Open Data Policy

splits.spatial_holdout_basins: Brahmaputra and Mahanadi (10,955 records, 415 flood events)

pan_india_dataset.known_limitations: Atmospheric variables represent gridded ERA5-Land reanalysis at ~9km resolution; SAR backscatter incorporates realistic orbital revisit and specular water reflectance models; river stage anomaly reflects upstream basin precipitation and stage warning levels.

previous_kerala_baseline.dataset_name: Kerala River Basins Hydrometeorological and Remote-Sensing Dataset (2018-2023)
previous_kerala_baseline.source: ECMWF ERA5-Land, USGS SRTM 30m, CIESIN GPWv4, Sentinel-1 SAR
